name: Jangli Amla Pickle
description: Small wild amlas from the hills, cut by hand and left to soak up mustard oil and masala until they turn soft and golden.

name: Galgal Pickle
description: Galgal is the big pahadi hill lemon. We sun-dry it and age it slowly, the way every Himachali home does in winter.
taste: Very tangy, spicy, a little sweet

name: Garlic Pickle
description: Whole pahadi garlic cloves, peeled by hand and slow-aged in mustard oil and spices.

name: Green Chukh
description: Chukh is Himachal's own green chilli relish: fresh chillies cooked down with galgal juice, ginger, garlic and roasted hill spices.
pairs_with: Siddu, momos, pakoras, anything that needs a kick

name: Lasoda Pickle
description: Lasoda (also called gunda or lasoora) is picked for only a few weeks in early summer. Made in steel vessels, sun-dried and hand-mixed.

name: Lemon Pickle
description: Himalayan lemons, sun-dried and fermented with pure spices until the peel turns tender.

name: Lingad Pickle
description: Lingad is the wild fiddlehead fern that grows by mountain streams in the monsoon. Foraged, cleaned and pickled the old way.
pairs_with: Rotis, rice, as a side with any sabzi

name: Mixed Pickle
description: Carrots, mango, lemon and green chilli, chopped fresh, sun-cured and aged in mustard oil. No two jars are ever exactly the same.

name: Mushroom Pickle
description: Fresh mushrooms cooked and preserved in mustard oil and pahadi masala. A favourite with people who don't usually like pickles.

name: Pahadi Karela Pickle
description: Small hill-grown karelas, cleaned and cut by hand (you can see the ladies doing it in our photos) and pickled with mustard oil.

name: Mango Pickle
description: The classic. Raw mango pieces in mustard oil with fennel, fenugreek and red chilli.

name: Green Chilli Pickle
description: Whole green chillies stuffed and soaked in mustard oil and masala.

name: Kathal Pickle
description: Young jackfruit pieces pickled until they turn meaty and soft.

name: Brahmi Sharbat
description: A cooling herbal sharbat made from brahmi leaves, the herb grandmothers swear by before exams.

name: Buransh Sharbat
description: Made from red rhododendron (buransh) flowers that our team picks straight from the trees every spring.
pairs_with: Chilled water, guests at the door

name: Rose Squash
description: Rose sharbat made with real rose extract. Pour a little in cold water or milk.

name: Orange Squash
description: Orange squash for hot days. Dilute one part with four parts cold water.

name: Lemon Squash
description: Fresh lemon juice squash, the quick nimbu-paani for when guests arrive.

name: Mixed Fruit Jam
description: Thick, fruity jam made in small batches.

name: Milky & Dry Petha
description: Soft dry petha in a sealed pack, the travel sweet.
